facts.fact: The government's December 2020 progress report says use of the SIGE, also called Educmaster, is compulsory in all public and private pre-primary, primary, secondary and technical schools.
facts.system: Système d'Information pour la Gestion de l'Education (SIGE), Educmaster

facts.fact: The report says the web application follows each learner's path and school results from a unique identifier now given to every learner (the Educmaster number), and credits it with ending forged report cards; it does not say how often schools enter the results.
facts.system: Système d'Information pour la Gestion de l'Education (SIGE), Educmaster

facts.fact: The report says the government has had the SIGE in service since 2016 as a reform of its own action programme, to give the pre-primary, primary, secondary and technical levels one reliable database.
facts.system: Système d'Information pour la Gestion de l'Education (SIGE), Educmaster

facts.fact: The Programme d'Action du Gouvernement 2016-2021 lists setting up the SIGE among its education reforms, and its December 2020 report names continuing to bring the SIGE into operation and upgrading it among the next steps.
facts.system: Système d'Information pour la Gestion de l'Education (SIGE), Educmaster

facts.fact: The report states that use is compulsory in every public and private school from pre-primary to secondary and technical, and gives no count or share of primary schools actually entering data.
facts.system: Système d'Information pour la Gestion de l'Education (SIGE), Educmaster
